title: Genie Agents
subtitle: From basics to advanced
promise: Build a Genie Agent your business team actually trusts.
description: Eighteen units, from asking a first question to running an agent in production — on one bank's data with nine flaws planted on purpose. You will be able to prove it's right, explain why it's slow, and know which problems were never yours to fix.

business.name: Business User
business.blurb: Ask better questions and read answers critically. No SQL.

author.name: Agent Author
author.blurb: Build, curate, tune, measure and own a Genie Agent end to end.

platform.name: Platform & Integration
platform.blurb: Governance, latency, cost, escalation, API and multi-agent design.

title: Agent Bricks
subtitle: Knowledge Assistant and Supervisor Agent
promise: Build agents over documents, then orchestrate specialists.
description: Knowledge Assistant for document Q&A and Supervisor Agent for multi-agent orchestration. Picks up where the Genie Agents course stops at 'what happened' and moves toward 'why'.
notes: Scope to Knowledge Assistant and Supervisor Agent only — Information Extraction and Custom LLM are marked legacy in the docs, so do not build curriculum on them. Cover Supervisor Agent's long-running task mode and the Supervisor API (Beta). Reuse the Meridian dataset and its document volume.
